verdict.rationale: Remote can be driven entirely without its UI. It has a REST API (e.g. `POST /v1/employments`) authenticated by per-integration tokens, and sandbox `ra_test_` tokens arrive by email with no dashboard step. An official CLI emits JSON or CSV from every command so output "drops straight into spreadsheets and scripts." Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, documented non-interactive (token/env-var) auth for the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
